questions.question: What information is available about THE ALBERT HALL MANSION?
questions.answer:
**THE ALBERT HALL MANSION (DarGlobal)** – https://darglobal.co.uk/one-of-one/THE-ALBERT-HALL-MANSION?utm_source=chatgpt.com  

- Part of DarGlobal’s “Premiere Edition Collection,” marketed as million‑dollar homes in the world’s most prestigious locations.  
- Situated in South Kensington, directly overlooking the Royal Albert Hall and offering views of Hyde Park, the Victoria and Albert Museum, and Knightsbridge’s luxury shops.  
- Historic Victorian residence designed by architect Richard Norman Shaw; construction ran from 1879 to 1886, exemplifying Queen Anne revival style with a red‑brick façade and ornate terracotta detailing.  
- One of London’s first luxury apartment blocks, originally catering to Victorian elites and still regarded as a symbol of prestige.  
- Detailed floor plans are not publicly posted; prospective buyers must join a waiting list to obtain more information.  

*No additional specifications (price, unit size, completion date, etc.) are provided in the available source.*
